executive_summary: The system is at high risk due to the end-of-support (EOS) of Windows 10 Pro, which could lead to security vulnerabilities and potential crashes. Immediate action is required to mitigate this risk.

predicted_failures.description: The Windows 10 Pro OS is reaching its end-of-support, exposing the system to security vulnerabilities and potential crashes.

root_causes.description: The use of an end-of-support Windows 10 Pro OS exposes the system to security vulnerabilities and potential crashes.

preventive_measures.action: Upgrade the Windows OS to a supported version.
preventive_measures.rationale: Upgrading to a supported OS will eliminate security vulnerabilities and prevent potential crashes.
